featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5 – Outstanding Service at FirstCry Korum Mall, Thane!

We visited the FirstCry store at Korum Mall today with the intention of only exploring options and purchasing later online. Even though we weren’t buying anything immediately, the service we received—especially from Hiteshwi—was exceptional.

She patiently walked us through all the essentials needed for the maternity hospital bag (pre and post deliver). What truly stood out was how clearly she explained the pros and cons of different brands, without pushing us to buy anything. Her guidance felt honest, informed, and genuinely customer-first.

Hiteshwi also helped us add everything to our wishlist, and her presence of mind really impressed us. She specifically advised not to add items to the cart right now, so nothing gets removed if it goes out of stock before our planned purchase next week. This is the kind of thoughtful, proactive service you rarely see.

She is knowledgeable, warm, and truly understands customer needs—qualities that make a real difference for expecting parents like us.

FirstCry management should definitely recognize her contribution. Employees like her elevate the entire customer experience.

Highly recommended store, and a big thanks to Hiteshwi for making the visit so smooth and stress-free!
